It has less Li per B than Li3BO3, so it may be somewhat more acidic, but it tests whether the borate family can go lower on the contact penalty.
proposal.motivation: Li3BO3 gave the lowest contact penalty so far (0.189, bin 9). The phosphate, fluoride, zirconate and chloride families all gave 0.31 eV/non-Li atom or more, and the Li3Al(BO3)2, Li4Ca(BO3)2 and LiCaBO3 borates were not better.

proposal.hypothesis: LiAlB2O5 is a borate that keeps the BO3/B-O framework that gave the lowest contact penalty so far (Li3BO3, bin 9). Al3+ is very hard to reduce, and the framework is wide-gap and insulating. It is less Li-rich than Li3BO3, so it may be less favorable, but it is an untested borate composition that could still lower the penalty.
